review_comments: You are missing the default case.
I would rather use an enum for name.

I follow the pattern from https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1494839b32aac4104e105bf02bfc6e477a798f06/pkg/kubelet/eviction/eviction_manager_test.go#L104

and
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1494839b32aac4104e105bf02bfc6e477a798f06/pkg/kubelet/eviction/eviction_manager_test.go#L112

In those cases, the name is the actual pod name AFAIK.  In your case you are really using the name to force different code paths.  I'd still prefer a enum in that case as its clearer what you want to do.
in my case I just use the eviction case name as pod name to match different podStats. So it seems like force code paths.
we can use enum as well, just need to add a field on struct ``podToMake``
I see.  Maybe we can leave it for now and see what a sig-node reviewer says.
